input.subject: R/007 – 8 Vellum Court, Brindlewick ZZ1 1ZZ – visit 29 Sep after 15:00
input.body:
Hi Rian,

Thanks. 29 September after 15:00 at 8 Vellum Court, Brindlewick ZZ1 1ZZ (ref R/007) fits the tenant's availability, so please treat it as the appointment.

Priorities:
1. Downstairs bedroom light: flickers and pops when switched on. Please inspect the fitting, switch and circuit and make it safe. If you find anything beyond a straightforward fix, please send a quote before doing further work.
2. Upstairs bedroom Samsung TV: trips the fuse when plugged in. It is not yet confirmed who owns it. Please assess it and report back only. Please don't repair, replace or remove it until we confirm.

Access: there is a dog at the property. The tenant will take it out during the visit. Please phone the tenant when you arrive rather than knocking.

Because of the popping, could you attend earlier if you have space? The tenant can also do 23 or 24 Sep after 15:00, or 25 Sep after 12:30. Please tell us if you can take one of these.

Thanks,
Donna, Northbridge Lettings
